visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An elderly woman with short hair wearing a red t-shirt and black shorts enters an IKEA store using a silver walker. A man's hand points toward the large blue and yellow IKEA logo. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) The woman sits on a grey fabric sofa in a showroom setting, touching the armrest. She has a large white bandage on her right knee. (3) She walks through the expansive store aisles, occasionally looking at items while being filmed from behind. She wears a grey surgical mask. (4) The woman stops to inspect a white cabinet with glass doors, opening and closing it curiously. (5) She is seen in an underground parking garage walking toward a bright exit with her walker. (6) Inside a metal-walled elevator, she smiles at the camera as her son's reflection is visible in the mirror. (7) She enters a Costco and picks up a large purple box of corn snacks from a stack. (8) In the bakery section, she carefully sifts through multiple bags of whole-wheat toast on a metal shelf, squeezing them to check for freshness. (9) She stands by a refrigerated meat display, pointing at various packs of red beef. (10) A static shot shows a bedroom corner overflowing with tall stacks of purple toilet paper packs. (11) Back in the elevator, she stands next to a full shopping cart, giving a thumbs-up to the camera.
